yes.0: So, about the #r<Pirate King's Treasure Map Book>#k I gave you... I'd love to get started right now, but the thing is, it has a bunch of parts that were ripped out. If you gather 6 Pirate King's Treasure Map Pieces from normal monsters each day, I can reassemble the missing parts and stamp them into this book.
yes.1: Now, #bno matter how often you bring Pirate King's Treasure Map Pieces, you can only receive one stamp per day#k.
